_about: Held-out routing eval for Ask DeepGrid. Each question names the curated answer (theme title) it must reach, or null for a question that must NOT be forced into a curated answer. Written on 18 Sep 2026 before the example questions in app/data/theme-examples.ts existed; never copy these into that file. npm run build:semantic picks the curated-answer threshold from this set (most correct with zero wrong and zero forced) and fails if that bar cannot be met.
